decision.observation: The corner contains a concrete slab leaning against the low parapet, with a block and debris at its base. Chain-link fencing and another roof surface are visible beyond, but no drop or opening is yet clear.
decision.hypothesis: Moving up to the slab should reveal whether it is a usable ramp or whether the parapet overlooks a lower route.
decision.memory: Repeated ordinary and crouch-jumps at the earlier plywood failed, and the fenced side walkway dead-ended. Inspect this new slab before attempting any jump.
